text:
maya: Heads up: I'm proposing we switch per-tenant quota timeseries default granularity from 1h to 5m for short-range console charts and alerts. Better anomaly detection for bursty tenants.

arjun: Thatould be heavy. Did you run storage + ingest numbers? :thinking:

linh: Cardinality will grow too because of route/metric tags. We need compact tag encoding or a retention compromise.

maya: Rough calc: top 500 tenants produce ~2.4M hourly points/week. At 5m it's ~28.8M points/week. With compression maybe 4-6x disk increase. Tiering and compaction could help.

sara: UX: can users opt back to 1h? We must not break saved dashboards. Also maybe client-side smoothing would help.

maya: Plan: add a granularity toggle. Default for ranges <=7d = 5m, >7d gets rolled up to 1h. Need backend rollup rules + API change.

arjun: Current payload is points: [{ts: 1680000000, value: 123}] with implied step=3600. We should accept a step query param and return step in response. Keep v1 stable.

linh: Suggested approach: introduce optional `step` query param (seconds). Default 3600. Response envelope includes explicit `step`. Old clients keep working.

tom: Migration: dual-read architecture. Write v2 timeseries table with 5m buckets, keep v1 table. Read behind feature flag.

maya: Dual-write at ingest sounds expensive. Alternatives?

arjun: Options: a) realtime fork in ingest (fast availability, higher latency risk) b) async aggregator that materializes both buckets (safer, eventual).

linh: I prefer async aggregator but that adds minutes of lag. Alerts may need near-real-time.

maya: Hybrid: keep an in-memory hot aggregator for the last hour for alerting, async job backfills persistent 5m buckets.

qa-bot: Test idea: synthetic tenant with bursts. Verify alert firing within 90s for hot-path.

sara: Frontend impact: client caches assume points length=(end-start)/3600. Must make clients resilient to variable lengths and steps. Also charting many tenants concurrently will increase payload sizes.

arjun: Recommend v2 of API: GET /v2/tenant/{id}/quota_timeseries?start=&end=&step=. v2 responses include meta.step, meta.source and series_id. Keep /v1 unchanged for stability.

tom: Draft rollout checklist:
1) create tenant_quota_ts_v2 schema (5m buckets)
2) async aggregator + hot in-memory aggregator for last hour
3) dual-read behind feature flag and v2 API
4) frontend v2 support + feature flag toggle
5) compaction: downsample >30d to 1h; retain 5m for 30d
6) canary 5% tenants; monitor p95 write latency, p99 query latency, storage growth

linh: v2 row shape (TSDB style) example: tenant_id, bucket_start (floored 5m), route_key, metric, value. We'll store tags compressed into a single encoded string to avoid extremely wide rows.

arjun: Add series_id stable across rollups so saved dashboards don't break. Also store compressed tags blob and update query planner to decode filters efficiently.

maya: Retention proposal: keep 5m buckets for 30d, hourly rollups to 90d, archive beyond that. Matches cost targets.

tom: I'll add a compaction worker: daily job to build hourly rollups for >30d and drop old 5m rows beyond 30d.

linh: Migration safety: introduce a per-region schema_flag to gate v2 writes. Rollout region by region.

maya: Monitoring signals: ingest QPS, aggregator lag, compaction backlog, query tail latency, alert firing latency.

infra-bot: deploy-check: unmet infra quota for new TSDB shards in us-west-2. Please file INFRA ticket.

maya: Opening INFRA-8234 and assigning to infra.

sara: UI adoption: show "higher fidelity metrics enabled" banner for canary tenants with an opt-out toggle. Track usage and feedback.

arjun: API nuance: maintain stable series_id between 5m and 1h rollups so dashboard widgets map correctly. Document schema differences in compatibility notes.

maya: Action items:
- arjun: draft v2 API spec and compatibility notes (ETA 2d)
- linh: prototype compressed tag encoding and query perf (ETA 5d)
- tom: infra ticket + compaction worker design (ETA 3d)
- sara: frontend migration plan + banner copy (ETA 4d)
- maya: canary list + alert tests (ETA 2d)

maya: Thanks all. Sync tomorrow 10am. :calendar:

linh: SGTM

arjun: on it

tom: will join

infra-bot: ticket INFRA-8234 created and assigned to infra-team.

maya: Closing thread here; will follow up with PRs and RFC links.
